Same question as WBCS 2016 Q176 (NITI Aayog set up by a Union Cabinet resolution); taught in niti_aayog and q41.
Ombudsman institution originated in Sweden — taught from the Maharashtra Lokayukta official site ('The office of Ombudsman has been in existence in Sweden since 1809'); lokpal section and exam q39.

What the second meeting of the NITI Aayog Governing Council emphasised is a dated current-affairs detail (land pooling / cooperative federalism discussion of 2015). The chapter teaches the Governing Council's composition, not the agenda of a specific meeting; no fetched official source used here records that meeting's emphasis.

The Constitution (123rd Amendment) Bill, 2017 empowers the National Commission for Backward Classes — taught as the enacted result: Article 338B inserted by the 102nd Amendment, 2018 (w.e.f. 15-8-2018); jatiya_commission section, exam_note in text and q17.

The Protection of Human Rights Act was passed in 1993 — taught (Act deemed in force 28 September 1993, s.1(3)); nhrc_gathon exam_note warns against the '10 of 1994' Act-number trap. Also mapped in POL-04.

NITI Aayog's North-East Region District SDG Index was released with UNDP support — a current-affairs partnership detail. The chapter teaches NITI Aayog's structure and objectives only; the UNDP partnership for that index is not in the fetched official sources used.

Statements: (I) Finance Commission is a Constitutional Body (POL-18); (II) National Commission for Women is a Statutory Body — taught here: NCW is constituted under s.3 of the National Commission for Women Act, 1990 (PHRA s.2(j) definition quoted). Keyed answer 'Both (I) and (II)' follows.

Year the Planning Commission was established (keyed 1950). Headquarters of the UN Human Rights Council (Geneva) — an international-organisations GK question, not India's NHRC. This chapter teaches the Indian statutory NHRC (HQ Delhi, PHRA s.3(5)); the UN body is out of scope.
